# heraut check

Run preflight validations.

Run both checks a release depends on: check config validates .heraut.yml offline, and check runtime
checks git, its identity, the repository's history and each release target's token. The exit code is
non-zero when either fails, so it works as a CI gate before heraut release.

## Usage

```text
heraut check [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut check
heraut check --env prod
heraut check --json
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--env <string>` |  | target environment (for per-env strategies) |
| `--json` |  | print the result as a JSON envelope |
| `--offline` |  | skip remote PR/MR metadata enrichment (forces enrichment_policy: disabled) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
